target: AAA real-time game volumetric weather system
principles: Preserve all existing cloud genera, weather cases, lighting, wind and interaction controls.
Do not regain compatibility or speed by removing the lighting system or silently reducing functionality.
Source byte count is a delivery metric; measure GPU time, frame pacing, memory and visual stability separately.
Store source code, seeds, parameters, provenance and numeric QA; no photographic skies, HDR images, generated artwork or imported cloud assets.
Keep graphical approximations explicitly distinct from validated fluid simulation and observed weather.
A successful build, shader compilation or first frame does not establish visual acceptance.

visualGates.morphology: No repeated mushroom columns or disc caps; distinct cloud families, hierarchical billows and connected masses.
visualGates.boundaries: No nonzero density on a sampling boundary, visible straight truncation, tile seam or split-colour plane. Check seeds and close views.
visualGates.sampling: No objectionable grain, banding, temporal flicker, ghosting or blurred silhouettes at the declared quality setting.
visualGates.lighting: Same cloud identity across dawn, noon, sunset and moonlight; preserve internal shadow detail, atmospheric colour, transmission and coherent light direction.
visualGates.motion: World-space advection with stated wind-from convention; smooth speed and direction changes; preserve cloud positions during parameter updates.
visualGates.performance: Record viewport, render resolution, hardware, browser, frame-time distribution and memory. Do not label software-renderer or single-frame checks as user-device performance approval.

codeReviewFindings.finding: hour and direction use ordinary target-minus-state interpolation despite periodic domains.
codeReviewFindings.requiredTest: Verify 23.95 to 0.05 hours and 359 to 1 degrees without an unintended full-cycle reversal.

codeReviewFindings.finding: The accepted volume-worker response calls windOffset.fill(0), including count and instability rebuilds.
codeReviewFindings.requiredTest: After measurable advection, change cloud count and convective strength; existing cloud positions must not snap to the origin.

codeReviewFindings.finding: incident() interpolates antiparallel sun and moon direction vectors before normalization. Near the transition midpoint the vector nearly cancels.
codeReviewFindings.requiredTest: Sweep dusk and dawn with fixed geometry. Inspect light direction and frame-to-frame radiance; blend light contributions without a near-zero direction.

codeReviewFindings.finding: Simulation time advances only after the GPU fence and caps each accepted elapsed interval at 0.1 seconds.
codeReviewFindings.requiredTest: Verify declared wind speed over equal wall-clock intervals under different GPU frame times; treat tab suspension separately.

releaseGate: Before presenting a new runtime, compare against the current baseline, check real-browser interaction and animation, verify public file identities and keep the previous working version recoverable.
